---
title: "Janvi Garg"
---

Hi, I'm Janvi. I'm an MS in Biostatistics student at Columbia University Mailman School of Public Health and a data analyst in the Boldrini Lab at the New York State Psychiatric Institute.

I'm interested in medical research, AI in healthcare, and health equity. I also founded and direct the ATLAS Research Program, where I mentor pre-undergraduate students on biomedical research projects.
